presentation.label: TONIC
presentation.summary: A Bitters-inspired multi-effect: drive, a phaser and one of decimate, crush, FM or ring mod, in either order.
presentation.overview: A Bitters-inspired multi-effect: drive, a phaser and one of decimate, crush, FM or ring mod, in either order.
highlights: Try each processor on the same phrase, then reverse the processing order.
usage: Add Tonic from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Try each processor on the same phrase, then reverse the processing order.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Tonic.
steps: Add Tonic from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Try each processor on the same phrase, then reverse the processing order.

controls.name: Mode
controls.doc: Four named regions: Decim, Crush, FM, Ring. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Amnt
controls.doc: Selected processor strength; zero bypasses it. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Drive
controls.doc: Gain-compensated cubic distortion; zero bypasses it. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Phase
controls.doc: Six-stage sine-swept phaser, up to 20 Hz; zero bypasses it. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Stereo dry to mono processed wet; exact dry at zero. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
